task: Generate Tripo-ready T-pose renders for the full BioMechania character roster (~150-200)
resume_brief:
FULL ROSTER T-POSE PIPELINE for BioMechania. Owner directive 2026-10-10: ~150-200 characters, each an individual Tripo-ready T-pose render, MDickie-style inspired-by-but-proprietary.

SOURCE OF TRUTH for names: /home/hatch/workspace/BioMechania/docs/MECH_NAMING_SLATE.md — 13 canon brands + 340 character candidates + 9 owner-approved anchors (SKITTER, POUNDCAKE, VANGEL, VERNIER, ZOYD, FORMCHAIN, MASKJACK, HENSHIN, RANGERDANGER). NAMING LAW: use ONLY names from that slate. Invent ZERO names. Every file named <CHARACTER>-<brand>-tpose-void (e.g. ZOYD-stampede-tpose-void).

ALREADY DONE (do not redo): SKITTER, POUNDCAKE, VANGEL, VERNIER white-void T-poses in /home/hatch/workspace/your_files/ (+ bruiser combat/breach).

PRIORITY 1: the 5 remaining anchors — ZOYD (STAMPEDE, Zoids-inspired beast mech), FORMCHAIN (MODESHIFT, Transformers-inspired), MASKJACK (EFFIGY, Bionicle-inspired), HENSHIN (CARAPACE, Kamen Rider-inspired), RANGERDANGER (PRISM, Power Rangers-inspired).

PRIORITY 2: the rest of the slate, ~150-200 total characters. Work brand by brand through all 13 (BROOD, PUMMEL, SCRAPKINGS, REQUIEM, COLDIRON, STAMPEDE, WILDHUNT, MODESHIFT, EFFIGY, CARAPACE, PRISM, CONTRAIL, PITLANE).

LOCKED FRAMING (every image): wide landscape, strict T-pose, arms perfectly horizontal with FULL hands visible + white margin left/right, full body head-to-feet with margin top/bottom, plain pure white void background, flat clean lighting, orthographic feel. Reference: /home/hatch/workspace/your_files/media-generation-bruiser-combat-tpose-void-fixe-0-1952ad51-4e36-43ab-a2a1-0862d7b5157d.webp — match this framing.

DETAIL BAR: panel lines, rivets/bolts, vents with slats, layered armor, greebles, visible joint mechanics. VERNIER is the owner's favorite — Gundam-lineage military detail is confirmed gold.

VARIETY DIRECTIVE (owner explicit): real variance inside each lineage. MODESHIFT: MANY Transformer variants (truck-type, jet-type, beast-type, construction-type, etc. — all original, none copying franchise designs). PRISM: Power Rangers-type zord styles (dino, ninja, samurai flavors — original). STAMPEDE/WILDHUNT: animal/beast-mix mechs (quadruped-capable poses where the design calls for it — T-pose or neutral stance showing all limbs). COLDIRON: Gundam-lineage variants. Every design original and proprietary to the BioMechania universe.

EXECUTION: you are the coordinator. Fan out to your own subagents in parallel, each handling a brand batch (one brand per worker is cleanest). Each worker uses media.generate_image (max 4 calls per response per worker — workers must batch across multiple turns). Output dir: /home/hatch/workspace/your_files/tripo-inputs/. Keep a manifest at /home/hatch/workspace/agent-ops/roster-tpose-manifest.json: {"<CHARACTER>": {"brand": "...", "file": "...", "status": "done"}} — update after every image so restarts resume cleanly. Heartbeat this checkpoint after every batch (>= every 10 min). Incremental progress. When ALL are done: mark checkpoint done and report total count + any failures.
